scripts.build: npm run lint && node scripts/clean-build.js && wp-scripts build assets/src/editor.js assets/src/frontend.js assets/src/settings.js --config webpack.config.js --output-path=assets/build && node scripts/package-build.js
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css
scripts.start: wp-scripts start assets/src/editor.js assets/src/frontend.js assets/src/settings.js --config webpack.config.js --output-path=assets/build
